verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a plausible ask for a password manager or authenticator suite, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no user-definable rules engine or event-to-action triggers. The llms.txt also declares 'Public API: None', and per-share link-expiration settings are an adjacent control rather than user-defined automation rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
